title: Render vocabulary — presentation patterns, as data
body: The neutral render families (party, step, spec, statechip, relation, measure…), one row per HQDM category that carries a render hint. Each row is an HQDM `pattern` — the abstract form a sign takes. Projected from the frozen CORE.renderHints by the bundle (never hand-authored, so it cannot drift), the same way the type lattice is projected into `types`. This is the D layer of dec-presentation made traceable: a presentation override or a renderer may name only a family that resolves to a row here. See [[computable-records-direction]].

title: Render family
body: The neutral renderer family a category presents in (the join key across D↔P↔R). A collection's default family is found by climbing `specializes` to the nearest category with a row here; a presentation override may name a different family, but only one that exists in this vocabulary.

title: Glyph
body: A neutral glyph for the family — a default sign, overridable by style. Presentation, not logic.

title: Default label
body: The default human label token for the family. The i18n seam: a label is a token (a `pattern`); l10n later maps token × locale (a `recognizing_language_community`) → a localized `sign`. Absent l10n, the token falls back to this default (or a humanized field id).
